description: This Java source file defines the IndexOperations class, which provides methods for managing MongoDB indexes, including creating, dropping, and retrieving index information.

classes.name: IndexOperations
classes.description: Provides index operations for MongoDB, including creating, dropping, and retrieving index information.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new IndexOperations instance for the given MongoDatabase.

methods.name: dropIndex
methods.description: Drops the specified index from a collection, handling the case where the index does not exist.

methods.name: createIndex
methods.description: Creates a new index on a collection with specified options.

methods.name: getIndices
methods.description: Retrieves all indexes on a collection, including the default '_id' index.

methods.name: getIndicesExceptDefaultIndex
methods.description: Retrieves all indexes on a collection, excluding the default '_id' index.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Helper method to get a MongoCollection instance for a given collection name.

methods.name: buildDropIndexRecovery
methods.description: Builds a recovery function for drop index operations, handling the case where the index does not exist.

methods.name: isIndexNotFound
